title: Describe tokens and keyword kinds
description: You can inspect the token record and constants that the lexer will use.

steps.description: Token stores its type, value, line, and column. Its representation includes the source coordinates.
The constants name literals, identifiers, operators, punctuation, keywords, and the end marker.

steps.question: Do true and false map to separate token kinds?

steps.description: KEYWORDS maps recognized words to token kinds. The final message confirms these definitions loaded; this snippet performs no tokenization.
